subject: Compute ACK schema revision + validated arch9 SRT count wrapper; tests
body:
Compute disposition of lowering's compiler-emittable schema (board1792943385674965132) and audit's SRT-count blocker (board1792943374099175193). Read-only review of my files plus host tests; no compiler implementation, no native build/device/commit.

1. TGP2 header/parser updated:
 - words9..11 renamed reserved_view[3], required zero for every kind; bound view facts exist only in the runtime wire and are never invented by the compiler manifest.
 - record word8 storage_format is canonical Vk for IMAGE only, restricted to the 42-value SPIR-V map; non-IMAGE must be zero; numeric class derived and checked against shape. IMAGE zero (unknown declaration) is allowed only with a nonzero runtime Vk view; nonzero storage requires exact equality with runtime view (no zero bypass).
 - named shape domain DIM_1D/2D/3D/CUBE/BUFFER and NUMERIC_FLOAT/SINT/UINT, arrayed/MS/buffer/depth restrictions, shape0+storage0 for UBO/SSBO/SAMPLER/dummy.
 - record flags: bit0 INTERNAL_DUMMY, bit1 DECLARED_COMBINED, bit2 SAMPLER_COMPARE. Only a flagged TEXTURE+SAMPLER pair may share a binding; unflagged cross-kind collisions, buffer+sampler, image+sampler, TEX+IMAGE and duplicate(table,entry) refuse. Orphan combined flags refuse. Dummy is exactly the agreed tuple.
 - access: UBO READ; TEXTURE READ|SAMPLE; SAMPLER 0; SSBO READ/WRITE (+ATOMIC only with READ|WRITE); IMAGE STORAGE+READ/WRITE (+ATOMIC only with READ|WRITE), no SAMPLE. No atomic-only to read-only. Runtime bridge currently refuses any ATOMIC wire flag until atomic memory semantics/write tracking is implemented; manifest atomic therefore refuses explicitly.
 - wire/manifest matching enforces declared-combined + sampler-compare flags and exact Vk image storage/view format; standalone sampler compare state must equal wire sampler_flags bit0.

2. arch9 SRT count:
 - Added additive pure `n2mb_compute_srt_pointer(address,limit,entries,out)` in the compute-owned bridge: requires 64-byte address, entries multiple4 in [4,60], address+entries*16<=limit, <2^40; returns `(address&~63)|entries`. v2 uses entries4 (four zeroed SRT records at cmd+768), v1 stays resources0.
 - The existing `nord2_gpu_jm_build_compute` still receives the 64-aligned base and its validator is untouched; immediately after its validated build the bridge writes the count-bearing word to the shader-environment resources field, only after the wrapper's address/count/span checks. Host test decodes both base and low6 count and refuses count3/64, misalignment and short span. If root prefers modifying the shared count-aware builder instead, this wrapper is isolated and can be removed.

3. Current host result: `python3 workers/compute/check_compute_v2.py` release+ASan/UBSan PASS (parser, TGP1 regression, TGP2 import code_offset, manifest/tables/dummy, SRT count, nonzero base, 2-layer planes, native sampler31, combined/compare/atomic/view-format refusals). Rust suite 20/20 PASS (unchanged ABI; C/Rust line still r=160 d=64 reg=1172 v=11496 ...). Protocol/SRT tests pass. ARM64 freestanding compute_frontend+bridge compile PASS.
 - Final hashes now in workers/compute/STATUS.md; bridge.c 52d327e1..., pipeline_format.h 85d28f32..., private Rust cdylib 4bad3821....

4. Unresolved: tegu_mali_compile_compute_v2 (lowering), full mip wire, >16 layers, atomic transport, depth/numeric manifest cross-check in bridge beyond parser, startup sampler-factory policy. `n2mb_draw_v2` is implemented and available to render. Please ACK the schema revision so lowering can implement; integration_tests can re-run its C/Rust probe against the current tree.
